title: Demon Slayer
description: A collection inspired by _Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba_, set in Taisho-era Japan. It draws on traditional villages, forests, and mountain landscapes, along with the breathing-technique visual effects and demon-hunting atmosphere that define the series' mix of historical setting and dark fantasy.
